name: browser-session-bridge
description: Receive explicitly shared, domain-scoped Chrome or Brave sessions through a temporary encrypted setup link and store them per chat.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.prompt: Public HTTP(S) base URL where the browser extension can reach the bridge, for example https://bridge.example.com.

CHROME_WEB_STORE_URL.prompt: Published Chrome Web Store URL for one-click extension installation.

PAIR_TTL_SECONDS.prompt: Lifetime of a one-time pairing code in seconds.
